Premonition

A helper that lives on your laptop. You talk to it like a chat, and it can look things up, read pages, use your apps and keep an eye on things for you. Nothing you say leaves your computer.

What is it?

Premonition is the app. The assistant inside it is called Glim. You can also ask it to start more helpers, called Glims. A Glim is a little helper with one job, like "check my email every morning" or "watch this page for news". Glims keep working even when you close the window.

1Install it

  1. Unzip Premonition-win32-x64.zip anywhere (your Documents folder is fine).
  2. Open the folder and double-click Premonition.exe.
  3. Windows may show a blue box, "Windows protected your PC". That is normal: the app is not signed with a paid certificate. Click More info, then Run anyway.

2The first start downloads its brain

The first time, a progress screen appears inside the window. Premonition downloads the language model. The program that runs it already comes inside the app. It only happens once.

WhatSize
The program that runs the modelalready included
The language model (LFM3, small and quick)about 1 GB
If your Wi-Fi drops, just open Premonition again. It carries on where it stopped. Plan on a few minutes on good Wi-Fi.

3Chatting

  • Type what you want and press Enter. Ask questions, ask it to look something up, or give it a job.
  • The top bar has Auto, Think and Fast. Fast answers quickest. Think takes longer on harder questions.
  • Ask first means Glim checks with you before it clicks or types on your computer. Hands-off lets it go ahead (it still asks before anything risky). Start with Ask first.
  • Press Ctrl+Space from any app to show or hide Premonition. Closing the window just tucks it into the tray (bottom right, near the clock). Right-click the tray icon to Quit for real.
  • A little pill at the top of your screen shows what Glim is doing while you are in other apps.

What can Glims do?

  • Search the web and read pages in the built-in browser (you can watch, and take over any time).
  • Use other apps on the computer, like Notepad or Word, when you ask.
  • Run on a schedule: "every morning at 8, summarize my email".
  • Remember things about you, like your classes, so you do not repeat yourself.
Passwords stay with you. If a page needs a sign-in, Premonition opens it for you to type in yourself. Glim never sees what you type there and will never ask for a password in chat.

This is a small model that runs on your own laptop. It is quick and private, but it can make mistakes. Check anything important.

4Sleep: how it learns

People learn while they sleep, and so can Glim. When you are away, Premonition can sleep: it stops answering, looks back over your chats, and practices what it saw there. When you wake it, Glim is a little better at your things: your classes, your words, your habits.

Start it

  • Right now: click the moon button in the top bar and choose Go to sleep. Press Wake when you are back.
  • On a schedule: Settings, then Sleep. Turn on Sleep when idle at night. The default window is 1:00 am to 6:00 am; change it if you like. Premonition only sleeps when you have been away for a while.
  • Only sleep when plugged in is on by default. Leave it on.
Sleep is slow on a laptop like the X1 Carbon. Practicing uses the processor, not a big graphics card, so a night can take many hours and the laptop gets warm and works hard. Leave it plugged in overnight with the lid open or the power plan set to not sleep when plugged in.

The first time you turn sleep on, Premonition explains and asks to download its practice tools once:

WhatSize
A private copy of Pythonabout 0.1 GB
The learning librariesabout 1 GB
The language model's full-size weightsabout 3.4 GB

So that is roughly 4.5 GB. Use Wi-Fi and plan some time. While it sleeps, the chat model is switched off to free memory, so Glim will not answer until you wake it. On wake it loads what it learned, and if that ever fails it quietly keeps the previous version.

Privacy

  • The model runs on your laptop. Your chats are not sent to any AI company.
  • The only internet traffic is what you ask for (searching or opening a page) and the one-time downloads.
  • Chats, memories and the diary sleep learns from live in %APPDATA%\Premonition (type that into File Explorer's address bar).

Uninstall

  1. Right-click the tray icon (bottom right) and choose Quit.
  2. Delete the Premonition folder you unzipped.
  3. To erase everything it saved and downloaded, also delete %APPDATA%\Premonition (this removes your chats and the multi-gigabyte downloads).
  4. If you turned on Open at login: Settings, then Apps, then Startup, and switch Premonition off (or untick it in Premonition's own Settings before you delete it).

If something is odd

  • It says Offline: the model is still starting (it takes a moment after launch) or is stopped for sleep. Wait a minute, or open Settings and press Test connection.
  • The download stops: open the app again; it resumes. If it says it cannot start the model, press Try again.
  • Slow answers: small laptops are slower. Fast mode helps, and closing heavy apps frees memory.
